$comment: Tests expected to fail. Annotated in the CI report and excluded from the 'changed' flag that decides whether a notification represents a regression. Entries match by file, optionally narrowed by a substring of the test title. Every entry needs a reason: the point of this file is the why, not the list. Reconciled against the first full run on dev (bootstrap4): 35 passed, 5 failed, 1 flaky, 15 did not run. See docs/e2e-ci.md.

entries.title: cold-starts offline into authenticated pet management from cached auth
entries.reason: page.reload() with the network cut needs a service worker, and two things prevent one existing: playwright.config.ts sets serviceWorkers:'block', and src/pwa.ts refuses to register under navigator.webdriver to stop stale hashed bundles being served across rebuilds. Overriding the config alone does not help because the app never registers.
entries.blocks: The describe is mode:'serial', so this failure takes every remaining test in the file with it.

entries.reason: Not independently broken. These do not run because the cold-start test above fails first and the describe is mode:'serial'. They should be reassessed as a group once that is resolved, not patched individually.

Email verification succeeds or fails depending on which container's queue worker picks up the job. backend_admin runs queue:work unconditionally while serves_web_app() is false there, so routes/web.php short-circuits before verification.verify is defined and the job throws RouteNotFoundException. A coin flip, not a selector problem.

entries.title: full password reset flow via email link
entries.reason: Same admin-container queue worker race as registration: whichever worker claims the notification decides whether the mail is sent.

entries.title: allows setting a real email for a Telegram placeholder account and verifying it
entries.reason: Same admin-container queue worker race. Passes or fails between runs with no code change.
